name: io.github.andreasjhagen/shell-commands
description: MCP server for running and interacting with managed Bash and terminal processes

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_SHELL
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Bash-compatible shell executable. Defaults to /bin/bash, or bash from PATH on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum unread bytes retained for each output stream (1024-10485760). Defaults to 262144.

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Milliseconds without interaction before a managed session is terminated (5000-86400000). Defaults to 600000.

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_MAX_CONCURRENT_PROCESSES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrently running processes (1-64). Defaults to 8.
